# sh-fpv-about

**Purpose:** Her bio and key facts.

**Built from:** sh-fpv-section-title + bio + sh-chip Type=Info (religion, community, gotra, mother tongue, marital status) + sh-button Ghost (Read More).

**Switches:** State = bio cut or full.

**Taps:** Read More → Expanded.

Full profile view (migration, not yet core) · 2 variants · [Open in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/l1SuD1Q1l8QXGvtomszGYW/Shaadi-DNA?node-id=2877-19581) (node `2877:19581`)

*Generated by `tools/components.py` from Figma. Values are token names; never copy numbers.*

## Types

### State=Truncated (Read More)

**When:** the bio is long. Read More expands it.

### State=Expanded / Short bio

**When:** after Read More, or the bio is short.

## Properties

| Property | Type | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| State | variant | Truncated (Read More), Expanded / Short bio | Truncated (Read More) |
